verdict.rationale: Context.dev is API-first: the product's core functions (crawl, extract, screenshot, monitor, brand data) are all documented as API endpoints with an OpenAPI spec, and the CLI/MCP/skill installs are just wrappers around that same API, implying no UI-exclusive functionality. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the web UI itself exposes zero features unavailable via API (e.g., dashboard-only settings) and independent hands-on verification of full parity.
